name: Wizard Storm
game_text:
<keyword>Spell</keyword>. <keyword>Weather</keyword>. To play, exert an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site.
When the fellowship moves from this site, every companion must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
flavor_text: “There was a black look in the sky, and the sun was wan. The wind had gone now round to the north-east.”
